question: On a merged PR, may the desk show Cleanup and Retro buttons?

options.label: Only after your go (Recommended)
options.consequence: Hidden until every PR in the sitting reads merged; the copy says your satisfied declaration is still owed. Pressing it is your own typed hatsu:cleanup.

options.label: Show on merge
options.consequence: Keep showing them as soon as this branch's PR merges, recorded as a ruling beside HR-366.

options.label: Never show them
options.consequence: The desk states the wrap-up prerequisites only; you type hatsu:cleanup yourself.
